description.value: Dosa Corner is an authentic South Indian restaurant on Fraser Street in Vancouver that has been operating since 2012. The menu spans a wide range of dosas, idlis, vadas, chutneys, and South Indian soups alongside chicken, mutton, and seafood dishes, earning a Best Indian Award in 2019. The restaurant bills itself as a family-style spot, making it a solid stop for cyclists wanting a filling, flavour-forward meal on the Fraser Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at dosacorner.ca fetched successfully and confirms the OSM address (6181 Fraser St, Vancouver) and provides two phone numbers absent from OSM. The About Us page explicitly states the restaurant has been serving since 2012, describes itself as a family-style restaurant, and notes dosas are appropriate for vegetarians and those with wheat allergies; the menu throughout labels items as '(Veg)' or '(Non-Veg)', confirming broad vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or water refill was found in the website content.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers (+1 604-324-3672 and +1 604-312-9297) — the primary has been used for the phone field.
Website still references 'COVID-19 SAFETY PLANS' on the front page, suggesting partial content staleness, though hours and contact details appear current (copyright 2019-2026).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active South Indian restaurant confirmed open since 2012 with a current website and matching address. A useful meal stop for touring cyclists on Fraser Street.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu extensively labels dishes as '(Veg)'; About Us page states dosas 'are usually considered appropriate for vegetarians and individuals with wheat allergies.'
